title: Ten Minutes Past Ten (counterfactual: renamed entities, shifted clock +2h)
source: Perturbed twin of story_04_ten_minutes_past_ten -- same gold graph, renamed characters, time offset +2h

threads.label: Costa, street lookout in the café

events.text: Nadira parks the van at 11:58 and keeps the engine running until 12:22.
At exactly 12:00, the crew slips through the service door and doesn't emerge again until 12:15.
Bex takes her position on the roof at 11:55, before Nadira even arrives, and climbs down at 12:10.
The vault door swings open at 12:05, just as the crew finishes cutting the last wire.
She edges the van forward from 10:12 to 10:25, the last stretch of the wait.
Bex radios the all-clear at 12:15, the exact second the crew re-emerges.
The crew splits the cash at 12:16, moments after climbing back out.
Nadira finally pulls away at 12:25, the instant her last stretch of idling ends.
Bex leaves the roof entirely by 12:20, five minutes after the all-clear.
She double-checks the side mirror in the first few minutes, from 9:58 to 10:05.
From 10:03 she keeps her foot hovering over the clutch, all the way until the engine cuts out at 10:22.
She cracks the window to listen at 10:10, sealing it again by 10:18.
Her hand rests on the gearshift from 10:13 to 10:20, deep in the second stretch of waiting.
The headlights flick on at 12:22 and stay lit until the instant Nadira pulls away.
Nadira checks her phone once she's clear of the block, from 12:26 to 12:30.
The crew jimmies the first lock at 12:00, done by 12:04.
From 12:04 the crew works the vault combination, finishing at 12:15 exactly when they slip back out.
Between 12:05 and 12:09 the crew stuffs the first bag, right as the vault door swings open.
The crew shoulders the bags at 12:15, hauling them to the door by 12:16.
By 12:17 the crew is stripping off gloves, finished by 12:20.
From 12:19 to 12:23 the crew wipes down the counters.
She settles low against the parapet from 9:55 to 9:59, the very start of her watch.
From 9:59 she keeps her scope trained on the street, until she climbs down at 10:10.
Between 12:02 and 12:06 Bex counts patrol cars passing below.
From 12:10 to 12:15 Bex waits crouched by the stairwell door, scope lowered.
At 10:15 she keys her radio open and holds the channel until 10:18.
From 10:18 she gathers her gear, gone by 10:20.
Lior is forced flat on the marble floor at 11:59 and isn't allowed up until 12:16.
For the first few minutes, 11:59 to 12:03, Lior stares at the barrel of a gun inches from her face.
From 10:03 she counts her own heartbeat to stay calm, all the way until she's finally let up at 10:16.
Between 12:05 and 12:09, Lior hears the vault door groan open just feet from where she lies.
From 10:09 she listens to bags being filled, right up until she's allowed to stand at 10:16.
At 12:16 Lior is helped to a chair, and sits there trembling until 12:19.
From 12:18 to 12:23 Lior gives her first shaky account to the responding officer.
Between 12:20 and 12:22 Lior remembers the exact words one robber used.
At 12:23 Lior finally asks someone to call her husband.
Costa watches the van from a café window starting at 12:08, never looking away until it finally pulls off at 12:26.
From 12:08 to 12:12 Costa clocks two patrol cars idling at the corner.
From 10:12 he tracks the van's every inch of movement, all the way to 10:26.
Between 12:14 and 12:18 Costa texts a single coded word to no one in particular, just habit.
From 12:18 Costa keeps one eye on the bank's side door, until the van finally rolls at 12:26.
At 12:26, the exact second the van pulls away, Costa exhales.
From 12:26 to 12:30 Costa lingers over a cold coffee, watching the street settle.
Between 12:27 and 12:29 Costa counts the pedestrians who never noticed a thing.
At 12:30 Costa finally gets up and walks the other way.
